description: Accumulator-leaf facts of ferrata-core (crates/ferrata-core/src/accumulator.rs), generated by scripts/gen-acc-leaf-vectors.py with hashlib. Shared with the bridge crate.
nodeEncoding: sha256(0x01 || left || right); the empty leaf is 32 zero bytes
pathEncoding: 32 siblings from the leaf level up; at height h, bit h of leafIndex is 1 when the running node is the right child; leafIndex < 2^32
identifierEncoding: sha256("ferrata/fact/acc-leaf/v1" || chainId (uint256, 32 bytes) || address (20 bytes) || slot (uint256, 32 bytes) || leafIndex (uint64, 8 bytes) || leaf (32 bytes)), big-endian; the root is not part of it
leafEncoding: opaque here: leaf i is sha256("ferrata/test/acc-leaf/" || uint64 i, big-endian)

invalid.case: leaf 0's path in the 9-leaf tree, against the 5-leaf root
the empty leaf at the first free position, with its true path
